Matches are address-range estimates, not rooftop surveys, property access instructions, or proof that the organization occupies the address. Unmatched addresses, campus points, FAA coordinates, regional areas, and generalized records are retained and explicitly identified. New public-address evidence and geographic qualifications are in the expansion and correction files.
